# AKSOS

AKSOS researches and prototypes systems that make complex environments easier to see, understand, and participate in.

## Knowledge layer

- Research index: https://aksos.net/research
- Regions: https://aksos.net/regions
- Projects: https://aksos.net/projects
- About: https://aksos.net/about

## Research principles

Research pages distinguish source-backed evidence from AKSOS analysis and disclose limitations. The knowledge layer is editorial research, not a chatbot or an authoritative replacement for the linked primary sources.

## Primary research questions

- Zimbabwe's approach to national AI strategy: https://aksos.net/research/zimbabwe-ai-strategy
- Current landscape of AI development and adoption across Africa: https://aksos.net/research/african-ai-landscape
- Barriers and opportunities for digital transformation in Zimbabwe: https://aksos.net/research/zimbabwe-digital-transformation
- Emerging governance frameworks for AI in developing regions: https://aksos.net/research/ai-governance-frameworks
